description: Eight VCAs in two groups of four, each group also summed to a mix output at the centre of its black hole

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, silent at the centre, full clockwise and full with the phase inverted anticlockwise; with no cable in that channel's input it sends a fixed voltage instead, 10V at full
Switches the four level knobs of that black hole from a linear response to an exponential one
Feeds the top black hole's mix into every channel of the bottom group whose input is empty, turning that group into four separate treatments of the top mix
Sets the voltage the level CV inputs of that black hole need for a full sweep, plus or minus 5V or plus or minus 10V, shown by the lit 5V or 10V lamp

inputs.text: The signal into that channel, which is multiplied by the channel's level and sent both to its own output and to the black hole mix
Adds to the level knob of that channel, a full sweep taking 5V or 10V according to the gravity setting of that black hole

outputs.text: That channel's input at the level set for it, or a fixed voltage from the level knob alone when the channel input is empty
The four channels of that black hole added together, clamped to plus or minus 10V

notes: the plus or minus 10V gravity setting suits envelopes and gates, and the plus or minus 5V setting suits oscillators and LFOs
